subject: Atelier-style customer roundtable dinner — venue quote & NDA
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@greentable.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal for Atelier-style customer roundtable dinner — quote & NDA

Hi Karthik / Lauren —

Thanks for considering GreenTable for the atelier-style roundtable. Per our conversation last week, attached is a preliminary proposal that includes: venue rental for private chef's table (18 pax), seasonal tasting menu (3 courses + canapes), AV technician for a short product demo, and Wi-Fi provisioning.

A few quick notes:
- Private room available the evening of Mon 16 Nov (7pm start) — we can do a seated chef's table for up to 18.
- Cost estimate in the attachment is a ballpark; we can itemize to match budget lines.
- We require a standard venue services agreement and a short mutual NDA for any pre-meeting materials. I attached GreenTable_Proposal_Atelier_20261108.pdf and included a DocuSign link for the initial contract placeholder.

Attachments: GreenTable_Proposal_Atelier_20261108.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/tx/ABC1234567890

Let me know headcount range, any hard dietary constraints (gluten-free, severe allergies), and whether you need a projector or demo monitor for ~10 minutes during the program. Happy to set a calendar hold once you confirm the date.

Best,
Elena Morales
Director of Partnerships | GreenTable Hospitality
elena@greentable.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@greentable.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal for Atelier-style customer roundtable dinner — quote & NDA

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and the proposal. A couple of clarifications from our side before we move to contract:

1) Capacity: we expect 12–15 external guests + 6 Redwood staff (total ~18). Can you confirm the private dining area layout to ensure conversation flows for a short demo?
2) AV: we only need a single 4K monitor and in-room mic for a 10-minute demo; projector fine if that's simpler. Can you confirm power access for a laptop?
3) Dates: Lauren, Monica — are you both okay with Mon 16 Nov?
4) NDA/Legal: our Legal team will want to redline the NDA; can you send the vendor NDA in Word? Please copy your legal contact if available.

If those look OK I'll put a tentative calendar hold and start confirming invite list + travel notes for a few customers.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal for Atelier-style customer roundtable dinner — quote & NDA

Team — happy to confirm 16 Nov as the target date. Quick operational notes:

- Tentative guest list (external): Sarah Lim (Aurora Corp), Tom Bishop (Finverse), Priya Desai (AtlasGrid) — final invites will go out once venue and NDA are confirmed.
- We're aiming for a tight guest list of senior product/engineering decision-makers — 12 external maximum.
- Budget: we should keep line item spend under $8k for food + room; please ask Elena for a detailed breakdown to fit within our events budget.
- Legal: Monica, please coordinate NDA redline with Elena's team.

Monica — please start the NDA review and loop in Legal (cc Jonas & Rachel for awareness). Karthik — if you can lock a provisional hold with Elena, I'll draft the invite copy and create a short one-pager about discussion topics.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: Elena Morales <elena@greentable.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Kline <ben.kline@greentable.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal for Atelier-style customer roundtable dinner — quote & NDA

Hi Lauren / Karthik —

Thanks — glad 16 Nov works. I've attached our venue contract (GT_Atelier_Contract_20261110.docx) and a slimmer mutual NDA (GT_NDA_Slim_20261110.pdf). Ben Kline (cc'd) is our contracts lead and will handle the DocuSign routing.

I revised the cost estimate to show a per-person food/beverage line and separate room rental so you can see where to trim. We can cut the tasting menu down to a 2-course prix fixe to get closer to your $8k target; I noted optional items in the contract.

Ben will wait for Monica's redline on the NDA. I can also send a Word version of the NDA if Legal prefers.

Attachments: GT_Atelier_Contract_20261110.docx, GT_NDA_Slim_20261110.pdf

—Elena

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@greentable.com>, Ben Kline <ben.kline@greentable.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@auroracorp.com>, Tom Bishop <tom@finverse.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal for Atelier-style customer roundtable dinner — venue quote & NDA

Elena / Ben —

All good on our side. Monica has provided a quick NDA redline (sent via DocuSign to Ben earlier this morning) and Legal will finish review today. I've attached a provisional calendar invite (Redwood-Atelier-16Nov.ics) and am confirming the final headcount will be 16 (12 customers + 4 Redwood).

AV: we only need a single monitor and mic — thanks for confirming power access. Menu: please proceed with the 2-course prix fixe option to keep us under $8k; we'll share dietary restrictions in a separate note.

Elena — please send the Word version of the NDA/contract for Monica's edits if possible. Ben — if you can route the DocuSign envelope with the updated NDA, we'll sign the venue contract once Legal clears the redline.

Attachments: Redwood-Atelier-16Nov.ics
Signed DocuSign (pending): https://docusign.com/tx/ABC1234567890

Thanks everyone — looking forward to an intimate, focused evening.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
